name: National Foods NW
old_description: Our National Food NW farms have provided the local community with the highest quality fresh eggs for over 60 years. Our values guide our everyday decisions — environmental sustainability, humane animal care, and strong stewardship in our community. Our team of dedicated employees work diligently every day to ensure that you have fresh eggs on your family’s table or for your food service needs.
about:
National Foods NW operates from Lind, Washington, with a business address in Everett, and has supplied the Pacific Northwest with fresh eggs for more than six decades. The company runs its own farms under the National Food NW banner and markets a specialty line under the Cherry Lane Family Farms name.

The operation produces shell eggs in several varieties—organic, cage-free brown and white, and omega-3 enriched—and runs a liquid‑egg processing line branded as Chef’s Select® for food‑service and manufacturing customers. The farms completed a full conversion to 100 % cage‑free production across Washington in 2024.

Customers include regional grocery retailers, food‑service distributors, and manufacturers that incorporate egg ingredients into prepared foods. The company emphasizes local delivery to family tables and commercial kitchens throughout the Pacific Northwest.

The business states that its decisions are guided by three pillars: environmental sustainability, humane animal care, and community stewardship. The cage‑free transition is cited as a direct outcome of those values.
